Package in.co.rays.model

Class TimetableModel

  • java.lang.Object
    • in.co.rays.model.TimetableModel
  • public class TimetableModel
extends java.lang.Object
    TimetableModel class handles all database operations related to Timetable. It includes methods for add, update, delete, search, and validations such as checking duplicates by course, subject, semester, and exam time.
    Version:
    1.0
    Author:
    Shad Khan
